candidates.draft_title: Add 'Principal Engineer' tier to coaching program for senior ICs
candidates.snippet:
[EXTERNAL] Gwen: Mostly steady. One small expansion idea — I've had a couple of quality managers ask whether the coaching could extend to their senior individual contributors, not just people managers. The argument is that a senior quality engineer influences a lot of behavior without formally managing anyone, and developing their influence skills would pay off.
[EXTERNAL] Gwen: I don't want it to balloon. If I open it to all senior ICs I'll have forty people asking. I'd want a defined tier — maybe the principal engineers only, which is about eight people.
[EXTERNAL] Gwen: Model it. If the number works I'll probably do it. It's a nice signal to the principal engineers that we see them as leaders even without the title, and this crowd notices signals like that.
[EXTERNAL] Gwen: You've clearly worked with engineers. They will absolutely notice which eight got picked and grumble about the ninth who didn't. Which is why I want a clean, defensible tier — "principal engineers, all of them" — so there's no favoritism argument.
